readings.moment: When the temple struck ten, Girard looked at his watch: four minutes to ten
Girard went out into the street to smoke
The piano started up in the salon just as Girard lit his cigar
The piano stopped (eighteen minutes to eleven)
Faint quick bells heard from the master's window (twenty-six minutes to eleven)
Girard came back into the house (fourteen minutes to eleven)
The hall clock had just struck eleven
Girard looked at the hall clock's face when he came in, which showed two minutes past eleven

durations: Girard smoked/stood outside from 10:21 to 10:46 on his watch (25 minutes)
From going out at 10:21 to lighting his cigar at 10:29 on his watch (8 minutes)
The piano played from 10:29 to 10:42 on his watch (13 minutes)
whereabouts: Girard sat at Aurèle's table at dinner
After dinner Girard stayed in the dining room with the brandy
Girard went out into the street to smoke at about 10:21 by his watch
Girard stayed under the front windows of the house
Girard did not want to go far in the snow
Girard came back into the house at 10:46 by his watch
Girard went up to Félix in the library after coming back in
Rosa came down the stairs (before Aurèle was found dead)
Vauthier has smoked cigars at Girard's elbow (on past occasions; no specific time given)
